s.g: Synonym of ouch (“cry of pain”).
Used for emotional emphasis.
An uttering of an 'ow'.
To be under an obligation to give something back to someone or to perform some action for someone.
ex: We owe it to our children to make our nation a better place to live in the future.
I owe Kevin five bucks which he lent to me last week.

s.g: To have debt; to be in debt.
To have as a cause; used with to.
ex: The record owes its success to the outstanding guitar solos.

tt: I owe it to my parents that I'm so healthy.
내가 이렇게 건강한 것은 우리 부모님 덕이다.

s.g: That owes.
Still to be paid; owed as a debt.

Any of various birds of prey of the order Strigiformes, families Strigidae and Tytonidae, that are primarily nocturnal and have forward-looking, binocular vision, limited eye movement, and good hearing.
A person seen as having owl-like characteristics, especially appearing wise or serious, or being nocturnally active.
An owl pigeon.
A politician with moderate views that are neither hawkish nor dovish.
A player or fan of Sheffield Wednesday Football Club.
Any moth of the family Noctuidae.

Belonging to; possessed; acquired and designated by; proper to; property of; titled to; held in one's name; under/using the name of. Often marks a possessive determiner as reflexive, referring back to the subject of the…
Not shared.
ex: When we move into the new house, the kids will each have their own bedroom.

s.g: To have rightful possession of (property, goods or capital); to have legal title to; to acquire a property or asset.
To have recognized political sovereignty over a place, territory, as distinct from the ordinary connotation of property ownership.
ex: The United States owns Point Roberts by the terms of the Treaty of Oregon.

s.g: To defeat or embarrass; to overwhelm.
ex: If he wins, he will own you.

s.g: To virtually or figuratively enslave.
A crushing insult.
A goal that results from a player putting the ball or puck into the goal of their own team; the resulting goal being scored for the opposition.
A blunder that damages one’s own prospects.
Having an owner who is part of a specified group.

tt: Tom claimed that he owned that expensive-looking red car we saw yesterday.
톰은 우리가 어제 봤던 비싸보이는 빨간 자동차가 자기 것이라고 주장했어.

s.g: One who owns something.
ex: The police recovered the stolen car and returned it to its owner.

s.g: The captain of a ship.

tt: I'm the owner of this company.
We spoke to the owner of the house.

s.g: The state of having complete legal control of something; possession; proprietorship.
Responsibility for or control over something.
ex: The successful candidate will take ownership of all internal design projects.
